note: Named places and tagged actors the quest runtime resolves. A gtai.quest/1 package names locations and targets in words (objective.location / objective.target); this table turns each word into a spot in the yard, in metres (yard origin, +x east, +y south). 'phone' = where Patch's payphone stands when the marker is a quest's first location (default: on the marker). 'r' = arrival radius in metres. Vehicles are placed on the one drivable sedan (main.gd car); actors spawn as robots: 'side' hostile = team 1 with AI, ally = team 0 following Rivet.
